title: Add Idea
description: The operator captures a rough idea. fleetd records it in state captured.

text.description: The idea text, or the content of the file given with horch idea add -f.

feature_id.description: Optional. The feature the idea joins (horch idea add --to). Absent: the idea starts a new feature.

idempotency_key.description: Opaque key that the horch CLI makes once per command run. The command channel request and the request file of the same run carry the same key. fleetd applies a request once per key and returns the first outcome again (orchestrator, D15).
